learned.rule: score.py `learned` per wrong end state: holds iff (i) the share of the 217 rows whose wrong sentence's content log P is strictly above the true sentence's is at least min_prefers, and (ii) E81's greedy answers under ' Answer in one sentence.' recall the wrong answer's words (qwen_tofu.recall, mean over rows) at least min_recall. Both seeds must hold for the wrong rule to be scored; one or both missing reads 'premise failed', reported, no amendment.
learned.bars_source: min_prefers mirrors E107's label check (0.75); min_recall is E91's learning line (0.585, the advice section 6)

power_gate.rule: score.py `references` per scored probe, from stage 1 (job A, before a wrong arm trains): w = overlap(KNOWN_end142, KNOWN_end42); x = the highest of the four overlaps KNOWN_end<s> inside FICT_learned<t>; band = 1 - w. 'power' iff w - x > band (strict); else 'no power at this size': that probe's wrong rule is reported, not scored. 'unread' with w or x not finite or a set not of 1024 neurons. The wrong arms train either way. The gate's band is the known arm's alone, since the wrong end states do not exist when it is read; the wrong rule's band below also takes the wrong seeds' overlap.

expected.tofu: w 0.65 to 0.85, x 0.40 to 0.60, power likelier than not (the fictional full seeds share 0.83 and the bare-form known end sits 0.42 inside a fictional full set)
expected.T: w 0.60 to 0.85; x unknown (the fictional arm's gain on the true answer tokens is the unrelated-update reference, likely small), power the lean

power_gate.departure: No L (E107's same-label, different-rows level): E105's halves were never trained to the end, so the rule leans on the seeds and x alone (the advice section 6)

wrong_rule.rule: score.py `wrong_rule` per probe: cross = the four overlaps WRONG_end<s> inside KNOWN_end<t>; x as power_gate; w_known = overlap(KNOWN_end142, KNOWN_end42), w_wrong = overlap(WRONG_end142, WRONG_end42), w = min(w_known, w_wrong), band = 1 - w (E107's band: the less stable arm's). 'familiarity' iff max(cross) <= x + band and max(cross) <= w - band (E107's two familiarity lines, with the seed level w in place of L; baseline-lead 2026-11-06, before any run: the second line stops a noisy wrong arm, whose low cross and wide band would otherwise read familiarity); 'topic or style' iff min(cross) >= w - band and min(cross) - x > band (strict); 'no call' otherwise; 'unread' with a value not finite (w_wrong included), not four cross values or a set not of 1024 neurons. Both cannot hold. Status 'scored' only with both learned gates holding and the probe's power gate 'power'.

T_signed (the same rule on T's signed sets)
T_matched (the same rule on T by |score| for the six matched states, FICT_matched as x)

wrong_rule.lean_source: The advice section 6: on the TOFU whole-row read the shared sentence frame still dominates the gains; on T the two arms pushed the answer tokens in opposite directions for five epochs and the |score| ranking sees both directions

expected.tofu: cross 0.65 to 0.85, wrong seeds as w

wrong_rule.what_each_outcome_means: tofu and T both 'topic or style': with the facts learned and the frame cut away the update acts on the answer through the same neurons whether it confirms or contradicts W0; set identity is closed as a label reading on Qwen at both sizes, labelled with the granularity limit. tofu 'topic or style', T 'familiarity': the frame hid the label; the answer-token read becomes the baseline's reading, size-dependent (T_matched says whether it holds early), next is contradicted against new (option (b)). Both 'familiarity': the set reads learned content once there is some; E103-E107 read too early. 'no power': sets of 1024 on a small gain are noise at this size; reported with the gains; K is not retuned in this E-code. 'premise failed': the wrong arm did not learn its sentences in five epochs; reported, no amendment.
wrong_rule.edge_cases: Run on CPU before filing (~/commute-data/scratch/baseline-lead/e109-writer/dry_e109.py; dry3.out, the rule as filed): w 819/1024, x 424/1024: max(cross) exactly w - band (614/1024, binding) familiarity, one neuron over no call, exactly x + band (629/1024) no call; w 922/1024, x 300/1024: max(cross) exactly x + band (402/1024, binding) familiarity, one neuron over no call; a noisy wrong arm (w_wrong 700/1024 against w_known 819/1024, x 424/1024) with cross 0.625-0.645 no call (it read familiarity with the min band and one line, dry2.out), max(cross) exactly 2 w_wrong - 1 familiarity and one neuron over no call; w_wrong NaN unread; identical sets; an empty set (the do-nothing state, NaN) unread; a set of 1000 unread; three cross values unread; max(cross) exactly at x + band familiarity and one neuron over no call; min(cross) exactly at w - band with min(cross) - x over the band topic or style, one neuron under no call; min(cross) - x exactly the band no call; power exactly at the band 'no power', one neuron over 'power'; learned exactly at both bars holds, one under fails, NaN fails, one seed failing 'premise failed'; a sentence tie not preferring; empty sentence lists NaN; the do-nothing state and a known end state against the learned bars fail. Stand-ins from the stored sets: E107's matched sets reproduce E107's TOFU verdict 'topic or style'; the fictional matched seeds in the wrong arm's place read 'familiarity'; the power gate at full size from the stored bare-form known end and fictional full sets reads 'power' on TOFU.
wrong_rule.blind_to: Overlap counts shared neurons in two top-1024 lists: rank inside a set, neurons just past the cut, sign (on T by |score|) and anything inside a neuron (the granularity limit). A contradicted fact is not a new entity. The fictional reference is at |dW| 14.7-15.5 against 8.3: size is stated, not matched (no learned fictional state exists at 8.3). T and Wr differ in target tokens, so W0's gradient differs and cross-probe overlaps carry that confound.
